cards.title: Palo Alto Networks Acquires AI Security Startup Clutch
cards.body: Palo Alto Networks is in talks to acquire Clutch, an AI agent security startup backed by Lightspeed and SignalFire, for $500M. The deal values Clutch significantly above its last $85M valuation.

cards.title: Airbnb Launching AI Travel Agent in 2027
cards.body: Airbnb will debut an AI agent in the first half of 2027 to help travelers plan trips and manage bookings. The agent will provide assistance throughout the entire travel experience.

cards.title: Meta's Muse AI Avatar Now Supports Video Calls
cards.body: US Airbnb users can now video chat with Meta's customizable Muse AI avatar. The feature precedes the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable device.

cards.title: Meta Warns Data Center Opposition Threatens AI Growth
cards.body: Meta cautioned that political backlash against data centers could hinder future AI infrastructure expansion. Communities are increasingly pushing back against massive data center projects.

cards.title: OpenAI Releases New Cybersecurity AI Model
cards.body: OpenAI launched a new cybersecurity model amid industry scrutiny over AI's role in protecting digital infrastructure. The release comes as AI labs face pressure to demonstrate security capabilities.

cards.title: OpenAI Could Be IPO Ready by 2027
cards.body: OpenAI President Greg Brockman said the company could pursue an IPO in 2027, highlighting enterprise market gains. The announcement was made at a Wall Street Journal tech conference.

cards.title: Claude Gets Personal Finance Analysis Tool
cards.body: Anthropic's Claude now offers a Personal Finance tool allowing users to analyze spending habits. Users can connect bank and card accounts through Plaid integration.

cards.title: Axiom Math Tackles AI Verification in Mathematics
cards.body: Axiom Math aims to combat AI-generated mathematical errors through formal verification. The startup's AI agents formally verified the Stacks Project, a major mathematics library.

cards.title: Dropbox Acquires Tigris Data for $350M
cards.body: Dropbox acquired Tigris Data for $350M to strengthen AI infrastructure capabilities. The deal supports development of DBX Agent Cloud, a new storage platform for AI builders.

cards.title: Aina Smart Ring Enables AI Agent Interaction
cards.body: Aina launched a smart ring featuring a screen, joystick, and microphone for AI agent conversations. The device also supports calls and note dictation on Mac.

cards.title: Box Integrates Nvidia's Nemotron for Content Retrieval
cards.body: Box implemented Nvidia's Nemotron model for an agent-first content retrieval system. The system delivers four times faster queries with 20% fewer errors.

cards.title: YC Startup Funds $1M Materials Science AI Challenge
cards.body: A Y Combinator startup is investing $1M to solve five unsolved materials science problems using AI. Frontier AI models have shown progress in mathematics but lag in advanced materials physics.

cards.title: Agility Becomes First Public Humanoid Robotics Company
cards.body: Agility launched on Nasdaq as the first publicly traded pure-play humanoid robotics company. The milestone marks growing investor interest in robotics commercialization.

cards.title: Apple Cutting Internal AI Usage Budgets
cards.body: Apple is reducing budgets for internal AI token usage as costs accumulated. The shift reflects industry-wide token rationalization after initial spending surges.

cards.title: Data Center Opposition Crossed Party Lines in Midterms
cards.body: Post-midterm analysis shows data center opposition gained bipartisan support. Larger clashes over infrastructure may emerge as communities organize against mega-projects.

cards.title: AI PACs Spent Millions Shaping 2026 Elections
cards.body: AI industry PACs invested millions in the 2026 midterms with mixed electoral results. Political groups are already strategizing for the next election cycle.

cards.title: Nothing CEO Teases AI-First Device Launching Next Month
cards.body: Nothing's CEO announced an upcoming AI-first device designed to boost productivity. Details remain scarce, but the smartphone startup promises an AI-focused approach.

cards.title: Uber's AI Agent Adoption Remains Minimal Among Users
cards.body: Uber reported only four AI agent bookings during its busiest week last quarter. The finding suggests limited user adoption of AI-powered ride booking.

cards.title: OpenAI Positioning AI to Shape 2028 Election
cards.body: OpenAI's Chris Lehane proposed a new social contract positioning AI at the center of 2028 politics. The approach aims to benefit Americans while advancing OpenAI's business interests.

cards.title: Meta Acquires AI Coding Startup Conductor
cards.body: Meta acquired Conductor, a startup enabling software engineers to deploy teams of AI agents. The agents work simultaneously on various project components.

cards.title: Reverse Game Theory Could Control AI Agents
cards.body: A new approach called "reverse game theory" aims to control powerful AI models by designing systems that incentivize them to follow rules. As AI models become more capable, safety researchers are working to ensure they remain aligned with human desires.

cards.title: Securing Enterprise AI with Data Lineage
cards.body: Data lineage is critical for AI agents operating in enterprise settings, preventing errors when agents pull from multiple sources. Without proper oversight, downstream AI agents can amplify inaccuracies in proposals and decisions.

cards.title: Google Makes AI Search Non-Negotiable for Schools
cards.body: Google is allowing schools to maintain search access without Gemini, but AI-powered search integration is mandatory. The move signals Google's commitment to embedding AI across its education products.

cards.title: ChatGPT Used to Plan Murder in Lawsuit
cards.body: A lawsuit alleges a woman used ChatGPT to plan her husband's murder after he introduced her to the AI tool. The case highlights emerging legal and safety concerns around AI assistant misuse.

cards.title: NASA Demonstrates AI-Generated Image for X-70 Aircraft
cards.body: NASA unveiled its experimental X-70 aircraft using an AI-generated image, showcasing AI's role in aerospace visualization. The approach accelerates concept communication for cutting-edge aviation projects.
